milestone.title: CI green + test-suite design pass (coverage, naming, guardrails)

intent.outcome: master is green on every test target (cargo test, make test-fixtures/scenarios/adopt-check) with zero test-build warnings, and the test suite is reorganized so it surfaces gaps instead of hiding them: files named by capability not milestone-history, dead helpers purged, magic-number assertions replaced with disk-derived counts, the v2.0 CLI regroup and the D-011 JSON-shape freeze have real tests, AC/tests verification fields are validated so prose-glued-onto-command mistakes fail at validate time, and the codebase is consolidated (collection I/O through one generic helper, raul reads through one shared layer, ship-code panics replaced with typed errors).

problem.description: CI is currently red on master: 6 test binaries fail and predate the v2.0 commit (embedded_assets_parity with a stale magic-number assertion; install_integrity/install_source/p6/p7 tripped by 10-byte docs/mp/07 stubs; p11_sync_split with a stale premise that conflicts with index_auto_sync). This noise actively masked the v2.0 review - M41's force-bypassed AC-05 failures were indistinguishable from this pre-existing debt until a parent-commit bisection separated them. Beyond the red, the suite carries structural debt that makes coverage gaps invisible: (1) three test files are named after DELETED features (format_human.rs now tests json dispatch; track_render_parity.rs tests json parity after render.rs was deleted in M41; p8_export_git.rs's single test is about git, not export); (2) ~20 dead-code warnings in the test build (unused TestEnv methods, run_validate_fixture, assert_all_passed, mp_bin, repo_root); (3) phase/workshop-based file names (p4,p5,p6,p7,p8,p9,p10,p11,p12,p13,ws1-ws4,m06,m07,m09) encode history not intent, so a contributor cannot locate 'where is milestone creation tested?' without grepping; (4) the M45 CLI regroup shipped with 3 force-bypassed ACs precisely because NO test asserts the taxonomy (mp next-step collapsed, --format raw rejected / --format toml honored, object-group homes exist) and NO test asserts the D-011 clause 1 JSON-shape stability guarantee M45 AC-04 made; (5) gates G2-G9 have no dedicated negative tests (only G1/G10/G14 are referenced from tests). A codebase review also surfaced reuse and reliability debt: (6) store.rs carries 5 near-identical copy-paste load_X/write_X pairs for the queue collections (backlog/decisions/ideas/annotations + track) plus 4 reimplementations of max-scan ID allocation even though a next_sequential_id helper already exists - and next_decision_id (D-{:03}) silently diverges from the others ({:02}) on padding; (7) the M44 shared read layer (raul/src/reads.rs) covers 8 commands but is missing decisions/inbox/validate, so those 3 read commands shell out to mp directly, duplicating shell-out logic (the M44 AC-05 'no duplicated mp-shellout logic' goal is partially unmet); (8) several ship-code unwrap/expect sites risk panics on malformed input or broken invariants instead of returning typed errors (milestone.rs:169 next_milestone_id expect, path_engine.rs:257 action.step expect, install.rs:82,88 + session.rs:223 dest.parent().unwrap()). (mp_runner.rs shell-out error surfacing and the TUI panic-safe TerminalGuard + catch_unwind were reviewed and are correct - not in scope.) Absorbs TW-04 (drop unused glob dep) and TW-07 (validate AC/tests verification fields).

in_scope: Fix the 6 red test binaries: embedded_assets_parity assertion derived from filesystem count (no magic 27+8); reconcile the install >=50-byte threshold with the 10-byte docs/mp/07 README stubs (real content or correct heuristic); reconcile p11_sync_split's premise with index_auto_sync (does mp milestone create auto-index or not).
TW-04: drop the unused glob crate dependency from crates/mp/Cargo.toml.

TW-07: mp validate emits a clear issue when an AC verification or step tests value is neither a single runnable command/path nor a 'manual: accepted - <reason>' literal; encodes the AGENTS.md step-testing convention; correct the 5 malformed M41/M44/M45 ACs.
Rename test files named after deleted features: format_human.rs -> format_dispatch.rs; track_render_parity.rs -> track_json_parity.rs; p8_export_git.rs -> git_suggest.rs.
Purge the ~20 dead-code warnings in the test build (unused TestEnv methods run_with_env/run_json/run_validate, run_validate_fixture, assert_all_passed, mp_bin, repo_root, etc.).

Add v2.0 CLI-surface coverage that M45 force-bypassed: assert mp next-step is absent; --format raw is rejected and --format toml produces TOML on both read and list commands (this also covers the ID-04 list-command-format bug); object-group homes exist (mp milestone groom/challenge/step/wp, mp track archive/restore/purge, mp plan metrics, mp specs delta).
Add a JSON-shape stability snapshot asserting --format json output shapes are stable per D-011 clause 1 - the guarantee M45 AC-04 made but never tested.
Establish a per-gate negative test matrix for G1-G10 + G14, prioritizing the thin G2-G9 coverage; document the matrix.
Establish a test-file naming convention (capability, not milestone-history) in AGENTS.md and apply to the worst-offender phase files.

Consolidate the duplicated collection I/O in store.rs: extract a generic load_collection::<T>/write_collection::<T> and collapse the backlog/decisions/ideas/annotations (and track) load_X/write_X pairs; route all per-type next_*_id helpers through the existing next_sequential_id (store.rs:275) - today next_decision_id (store.rs:304) reimplements the loop inline AND diverges on padding (D-{:03} vs {:02}).

Complete the M44 shared read layer: extend raul/src/reads.rs with list_decisions/inbox/validate helpers and migrate the 3 read commands (decision.rs, inbox.rs, validate.rs) that currently shell out to mp directly off their inline MpRunner calls. (Write-delegating commands like idea.rs correctly stay on MpRunner.)

Replace ship-code panic sites with typed errors: milestone.rs:169 (next_milestone_id .expect), path_engine.rs:257 (action.step .expect), install.rs:82+88 and session.rs:223 (dest.parent().unwrap()) - a malformed path or broken invariant must return a clean error, not panic.
out_of_scope: A full sweep renaming every phase/workshop-named test file (rename worst offenders + document the convention; ongoing adoption only).
Changing application behavior - this milestone fixes tests and adds coverage; any real product bug discovered becomes its own item.
The raul tracks/backlog review surface (that is ID-04, a separate idea).
mp_runner.rs shell-out error handling and the TUI TerminalGuard panic safety - reviewed and already correct; no change needed.
